title: A Sleigh of One's Own
overview: One woman's journey of self-discovery and coming to terms with her husband's sexuality. That woman? Mrs. Claus.

title: Third Love
overview: It's a story about some teen aged boy and girl of a University. A romantic story but in this story viewers will get a heavy sad and deep message. Which will make them realized a universal truth about transgender people and their feelings.

title: High in the Clouds
overview: After he accidentally sparked a revolution against Gretsch, the bossy diva-owl who has banned all music from his town, a teenage squirrel named Wirral embarks on an extraordinary journey to set music free.

title: Untitled Ocean's Prequel
overview: Follows Danny Ocean's parents, two masterminds, as they pull off an elaborate heist at the 1962 Monaco Grand Prix.

title: Twisted
overview: As the heir to her parents’ legendary pizzeria, Angelina, a feisty Italian teenager, fears breaking tradition might break their hearts. As her desire to break free grows, so do her lies. But when her web of deceit spins out of control, she opens a portal to a wondrous and treacherous mythical underworld putting her family in grave danger. To right her wrong, she is forced to team up with a neurotic but sensitive, truth-telling monster. The unlikely duo sets off on a mind-blowing journey to save the very traditions Angelina wanted to leave behind. A modern coming-of-age adventure, Twisted explores the universal themes of soul-searching. It challenges our relationship with truth, lies and looks at how life-changing decisions can sometimes affect the people we love.

title: Star Wars: Starfighter
overview: An original story set approximately five years after the events of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.

title: Drodwel
overview: Paramedic-for-hire Drodwel and his robot companion Surly race through the sunset city in hope of saving the life of an injured revolutionary.

title: Orphans
overview: A ruthless con artist targets a wealthy European household, but her calculated scheme hits an unexpected snag when someone discovers her dark past and vows to expose her true identity.

title: Puro R.A.P.
overview: Five young Panamanian freestyle artists fight to turn their craft into a way of life, as rap becomes their only voice in a country that doesn’t always listen.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: Prodigal Son
overview: Aaron "Amadeus" Overlake is a visionary filmmaker revered for his genius but plagued by his own demons—a volatile alcoholic whose life is consumed by anger, controversy, and from a bitter heartbreak. As tabloids revel in his self-destruction, Aaron’s only anchor is his best friend, Santiago "Baron" Gonzalez, a charismatic actor fresh out of rehab, fighting to rebuild his career.  Bound by shared struggles and a tangled history, Aaron and Santiago navigate the toxic undercurrents of fame and friendship. As Aaron embarks on his next masterpiece, his chaotic life threatens to destroy everything he holds dear.

title: A Grand Biltmore Christmas
overview: In 1895, Elizabeth meets Michael, a teen trespasser at Biltmore House who vanishes. When he returns 20 years later, a magic hourglass pulls her to the present. She must return home before being found and before love alters her destiny.

title: Unholy Night
overview: The film centers on Gino, whose traditional Italian family Christmas Eve celebration descends into chaos when his deceased grandmother returns from the dead and embarks on a killing spree.  As more dead relatives begin appearing throughout the neighborhood, Gino must find a way to eliminate the holiday revenants and make it through the family gathering alive.

title: Little Flower
overview: An ominous dream pushes Layla, a directionless twenty-something to reconnect with an old friend.

title: UK Holiday
overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

title: The Last Temptation of Becky
overview: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

title: Lights! Camera!! Scream!!!
overview: Three friends went to Maine to make a horror film.  They disappeared. Their footage didn't.

title: Brute 1986
overview: Leather Kobra, a Sunset Strip-style glam metal band, films a music video in an abandoned Western town in the middle of nowhere. Ignoring ‘no trespassing’ signs, the rebellious group have no idea they are being watched by the Birdy family, who will meet them with a level of brutality that is as vicious as it is creative.

title: Everest: The Other Side
overview: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

title: Archives from Hell: The Making of Demo_N
original_title: Archives from Hell: The Making of Demo_N
overview: A retrospective documentary series on the innovative experience in screenlife horror - Demo_N.

title: The Lost Princess of Hackney
overview: A self-proclaimed Elvish Princess finds herself stranded on our world in the Hackney Marshes. Without any magic to return home, she searches for purpose but develops an unlikely friendship with a sceptical student filmmaker.

title: Like Lightning
overview: An erotic sense-memory, archival intimacy.

title: A Real Grey Area
overview: Attempting to stage an historical reenactment on Coney Island, a contractor working for a powerful client speaks with a representative from a rental company regarding the unconventional use of an electric generator.

title: Roman Charity
overview: Building on my background in academic drawing, I create a painting that reinterprets Rubens’ Roman Charity from the viewpoint of its female figure. This painting then appears as a prop in the video, becoming a means to inscribe my own biography and to explore questions of gaze, female subjectivity, memory, and the boundaries of the permissible.

title: When Wine Meets Coffee
overview: When Claire, a sophisticated wine expert, travels to Costa Rica, her carefully ordered world collides with Alex, a passionate coffee producer deeply rooted in his family’s land. As wine and coffee, past and present, begin to intertwine, an unexpected connection challenges what they thought they knew about love, memory, and the paths that bring people together.

title: Symbiotica
overview: When Margerie Dollop gives birth to her unconventional baby, she is met with an impossible decision once something starts knocking from its insides.

title: Liz Here Now
overview: Liz Baxter, who works as a nanny for a prominent, has a white family in Oakland, California, during the rise of the Black Panther Party in 1967. When Liz discovers that the Connor children are suffering under the hand of their mother, Jane, and attempts to step in to protect the children, she’s accused of participating in a Black Panther conspiracy.

title: Morning Echo
overview: After months of silence, Gabriel wakes to find his ex-boyfriend, Omar, in his kitchen cooking breakfast as if nothing ever happened. As the morning unfolds, unspoken tensions and unresolved feelings rise to the surface, forcing Gabriel to confront whether intimacy can exist without truth, or if some things are better left in the past.

title: Doctor Doomscroll
overview: An isolated young woman fights to survive a demonic entity that preys on people who are stuck in a social media doomscroll. To make it out alive, she must confront the purposeless person she’s become—and the loved ones she’s pushed away.

title: Psalms of Sorrow
overview: Worn down by a failing body and a father who has fallen into silence, Isaac is forced to choose between saving himself and remaining true to his conscience in a world where survival comes at a heavy price.

title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
original_title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

title: The Quiet Hour
overview: "The Quiet Hour" is a gripping, intimate drama set over the course of one relentless night shift in an NHS hospital, where overworked nurse Riya battles exhaustion, guilt, and the ghosts of past mistakes while caring for her patients. As she juggles a collapsing system, an understaffed ward, and a stream of emergencies—from dying patients to Fred, a combative amputee, and a medical error that nearly costs a life—her professional composure begins to fracture. Haunted by the memory of a young girl she couldn’t save and the growing distance from her teenage daughter, Riya’s night spirals into a raw reckoning with compassion, burnout, and the quiet heroism that holds the health service together.

title: Jamais Vu - Reverse Fall
overview: In the near future, mercenary sandmen from the Moon control Earth's gravity, rented out like electricity or water. Those unable to pay face exile into a black hole. Amid the chaos, a boy named Keyvan must find his way.

title: Letters
overview: In the school hallway, Anita excitedly tells Chloe that she plans to confess her feelings to Antoni after school. Later, Anita goes to the garden gazebo and is devastated to find Antoni close to Bianca, who is holding Anita's personal love letter. Amidst a sudden thunderstorm, Bianca mocks Anita from afar and embraces Antoni, causing Anita to flee in tears. A flashback reveals that years prior, a science fair project built by Anita and Bianca malfunctioned and exploded in front of a laughing crowd, leading a humiliated Bianca to tear off her matching necklace and blame Anita for ruining her. In the present day, Bianca corners Anita in the school bathroom to confront her about the past. During the heated argument, Bianca admits her deep insecurity and resentment over the science fair disaster. Seeking closure, Anita offers Bianca the "B" necklace she has kept for years, but Bianca refuses it and walks out, leaving Anita alone with her reflection and unresolved tension.

title: Liv's Last Ride
overview: When an unexpected visitor disrupts a bachelorette party at a secluded cabin, the bridal party must bury old grudges and their shared dark history in order to survive the night.

title: Sydney Cash Makes Too Much Art
original_title: Sydney Cash Makes Too Much Art
overview: Sydney Cash is an 80-year-old artist who can’t stop making art. When space runs out and time grows short, his family faces an urgent decision about the fate of his life’s work. Turning the camera on his father’s artistic legacy, a son confronts how a lifetime of compulsive creating impacted their family.

title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
overview: Hyper organized single mom and party planner Lexi, her free-spirited mother June, and teen daughter Piper are set to spend Christmas at a local ski resort after Lexi is hired to organize their annual holiday party. Upon arrival, she immediately butts heads with Ridge, the ski instructor and son of the lodge's owner, Dan.

title: Duckweed
overview: Obscure, aging, and living on the outskirts of London, writer of supernatural fiction Quentin Crisp asks himself a fundamental existential question: ‘Who am I?' This feature-length film-essay is structured around readings of Crisp’s own zuihitsu of the same name, which, in essence, is the story of his life. As we follow Crisp on a walk deeper into the ‘‘little wood’’ of his private landscape, the binaries of success and failure begin to fade away.

title: Speechless
overview: Already feeling like a fish out of water among his straight, British-Jamaican clan, Drew’s anxiety spikes when someone steals the speech he’s meant to give at his sister’s wedding.

title: F*CK HALLOWEEN
overview: Two friends go trick-or-treating with one goal: steal as much candy as possible. Unfortunately, they choose the wrong house to f*ck with.

title: Andhkar
overview: Andhkar is a suspense thriller about the murder of a famous painter's wife in her bungalow. Set over one night from 6 p.m. to 6 a.m., it is a classic murder mystery where nothing is as it seems.

title: Take It Back
overview: On the eve of college, aspiring filmmaker Anna clashes with her controlling mother. A chance encounter with a man from her childhood resurfaces a painful secret, pushing years of resentment to a breaking point.

title: Hot Dirty Blood!
overview: Upcoming short film release by Sam Aotaki and Sam Spoll. Plot details TBA.

title: Concrete Cowboy
overview: Jack, a wannabe cowboy flees to New York City to escape his past. But when his former gang members Ricky and Helen Hatchet come to town, they make sure that task ain't so easy.

title: Heather McMahan: By a Thread
overview: Everyone’s stressed. We’re all hanging on BY A THREAD. But don’t worry, we can all laugh about it together. BY A THREAD. October 16. Hulu.

title: The Other Room
overview: After a late-night Tinder hookup, a young Black man is cornered by his date's white parents whose wine and questions mask something far worse waiting in the other room.

title: Vespers

title: Quick Fix
overview: Norman has been living his life through labels. (literally). Julius is trying to help Norman navigate through his strange "illness."

title: Tina and the Fly
overview: After a terrible breakup, a woman develops a toxic codependent relationship with a house fly.

title: Movie for Grandma
overview: A young boy attempts to capture his grandma's story in the brief window before she must go.

title: Swipe White
overview: After impulsively posing as white on a dating app, Heem, a gay Black New Yorker, finds his ideal match. But as their romance blossoms, he must confront his lie to have a real shot at love.

title: Krew
overview: A young film student joins a foreign horror film shooting in the woods, only to realize she can’t understand the language—or the dark rituals that may claim her as their final sacrifice.

title: Ana the Cleaner
overview: Ana spends her days cleaning the homes of Chicago's elite while feeding an obsession with true crime. When one of her clients suddenly disappears, Ana becomes convinced she's uncovered the perfect murder.

title: Doober Driver R Us
overview: Mockumentary about Day in the Life of a Doober Driver

title: Dolioo
overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

title: Bunker Heights
overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

title: Loved One
overview: Sandy's compulsive need to save her eldest daughter Jess collides with her responsibility to celebrate her younger daughter's college graduation, forcing her to confront the line between love and obsession.

title: Trevor Lies
overview: The bizarre tale of a young boy and his puritan family who must grapple with the morality and consequences of deceit

title: Closing Time
overview: "Closing Time"  sees Mo, a gifted but undocumented migrant working in his uncle’s kebab shop, keep his culinary ambitions hidden until he meets Laila, a thoughtful lawyer trapped in a stagnant engagement. Their connection grows over late-night conversations and cooking sessions, where Laila encourages Mo to pursue his dreams and he gently challenges her to confront the life she’s settled for.

title: Roof
overview: Trapped on the roof of a skyscraper over a holiday weekend and without communication, two co-workers attempt to escape in increasingly dangerous ways as their health deteriorates while both realize how much they have ruined their lives.

title: Double Trouble
overview: Two witty sisters in Vegas get tangled in a holiday heist and join forces with an ex-MI6 guard to outmaneuver a master thief and recover a diamond gauntlet before Christmas.

title: Wounds
overview: Caleb, a young SFX makeup artist struggles to create realistic effects until he witnesses a brutal murder. Intrigued by what he saw, he descends into a psychological abyss as he takes on extreme measures to create his masterful effects.

title: Cherubs
overview: In this comedic mockumentary, a group of Cherubs working for Cupid begin to sabotage each others work after being threatened with downsizing leading to a massive prank war.

title: Ada Kesedihan di Matamu
overview: A man sees a woman being threatened and wants to be her hero but he never imagined how completely his life would change because of it.

title: Who is Peter Murray?
overview: Sean confronts his past during a seemingly normal podcast episode.

title: One Bench or Another
overview: After Bart's usual bench in the park is taken he is driven to sit next to Sam which leads to the most whirlwinding encounters that could happen on a park bench.

title: Render
overview: Luke takes a new drug called 'RENDER' that gives him intense euphoria while he regularly sees a prostitute that he has an abnormal relationship with. After taking this new drug for a period of time, things start to spiral out of control for Luke.

title: From the Ashes
overview: Two old buddies reunite to scatter the ashes of their friend and brother. Unbeknownst to them, they are soon to be visited by their late companion from beyond the grave.

title: Village Idiot
overview: "Village Idiot" is a sharp, heartfelt comedy-drama about a stubborn English grandmother, Barbara, who chains herself to her cottage to resist eviction by High Speed train developers. She then discovers that the company’s liaison sent to remove her is her estranged grandson, Peter. What follows is a clash between generations, class, and values: Barbara’s fierce attachment to home and identity versus Peter’s desperate need to hold onto his corporate job. As their battle becomes public, turning into a small-town spectacle of protest, press, and community chaos, both are forced to confront what “home” really means, and how love, pride, and belonging can both bind and divide a family. Witty, warm, and deeply human, "Village Idiot" captures rural England on the brink of change with equal parts humour and heartbreak.

title: Secrets of the Southwest
overview: Discover the hidden stories Britain's southwest has to offer. From Foxes fighting on the streets of Bristol to Puffins looking for love on Skomer Island.

title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
original_title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
overview: Meet the inspiring individuals and communities who work to protect our most beloved UK wildlife.

title: Fruit & Nut
overview: The untold story of the most famous duo of all time.

title: Robbin' the Hood
overview: Two brothers are roped into a scheme to rob from the rich and give to the poor, only to find their victims are not who they think they are.

title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

title: Halloween Candy 2
overview: One year after surviving a Halloween massacre, Candee faces a new nightmare when a masked killer traps her and her friends inside a house where every secret is deadly. As the body count rises, she'll learn that the true monsters aren’t always the ones wearing masks.

title: Better call coke
overview: ARJUN, A YOUNG BOY PASSIONATE ABOUT FILMMAKING, CELEBRATES HIS ACCEPTANCE INTO A PRESTIGIOUS FILM SCHOOL BUT HIS DREAMS ARE CRUSHED BY HIS FATHER'S EXPECTATIONS. YEARS LATER, ARJUN DIRECTS A SHORT FILM BASED ON HIS OWN HEARTBREAK. NARRATED BY A COKE BOTTLE SYMBOLIZING SILENT DREAMS, THIS STORY CAPTURES THE EMOTIONAL JOURNEY OF BATTLING SOCIETAL NORMS AND FINDING STRENGTH IN FAILURE.

title: Moroccan Modern Life
overview: Soumia Naji explores her life in Morocco and her eventual arrival to Orlando,  Florida.

title: Uprooted
overview: Just as a couple prepares to welcome their long-awaited child, a devoted couple meets a troubled teen whose wounded heart resists faith. Their paths intertwine in a story of love, healing, and unexpected grace.

title: Fuck Mr Flanagan
overview: A journey into the woods causes two stoners to question their friendship and purpose in life - while they try to avoid a devious figure named Mr Flanagan.

title: Family Game Night
overview: A well-meaning mom tries to unite her fractured family with a seemingly innocent game night. Amid sibling rivalries and issues with Maya's new boyfriend, the evening spirals into chaos until an unexpected truth offers a fragile chance at healing.

title: Gertrude the Gusher
overview: A woman goes on a date.

title: 233 Years of Luck
overview: A young woman gets more than she bargained for when trying to sell insurance to an unusual couple.

title: Brothers in Blood: Black in Vietnam
original_title: Brothers in Blood: Black in Vietnam
overview: In the 1960s and early 1970s, Black Americans fought two wars, one in Vietnam and one at home for civil rights. As disproportionate numbers of Black men were drafted and sent to the front lines, the racism they faced in the United States followed them overseas. Through firsthand testimony, Brothers in Blood: Black in Vietnam examines discrimination within the military and the lasting physical, emotional, and social consequences veterans faced after returning home.

title: Art of Destruction
overview: We follow the story of The Thinker bombing at the Cleveland Museum of Art, trying to solve the mystery behind it because no one was ever caught. By following this case, we unravel the whole landscape of Cleveland and the USA in the 60s/70s - student protests, social justice movements, anti-war movements, and radical militant groups. We give a context to the bombing, which is symbolic on so many levels - it's an art piece that randomly became a target for political violence that, by being left unrepaired, became a reminder of the complicated history of the 60s/70s. The Thinker is a silent witness to this fascinating decade, looking down from his pedestal, still thinking about our place in the world as humans.

title: Wild
overview: Wild is a survival dramedy set in the breath-taking yet unforgiving Scottish Highlands. Lou, Dev, and Alistair, three old friends clinging to their annual wild camping tradition, begin with banter, nostalgia, and amateur vlogging, but soon unravel into a battle of egos, secrets, and survival when they get lost, food runs short, and friendships fracture. At once funny, poignant, and unsettling, "Wild" explores the line between adventure and recklessness, and how toxic masculinity has become a huge part of the epidemic decline in men’s mental health.

title: Stells
overview: The fate of the controversial establishment Bunny Smiles Incorporated lies in the hands of one facility caretaker.  A Walten fan-film based on the hit series "The Walten Files" created by Martin Paredes. We see the true nature behind why Bunny Smiles Incorporated plan to relocate the franchise's lead establishment "Bon’s Burgers".

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: Being Gregor
overview: Take on the life of Gregor Samsa, a weary salesman whose world unravels as he transforms from cherished member of the family, into a hideous insect. We all carry multiple identities... but where do you truly belong?

title: Bill's Cube
overview: Bill, an underachieving stoner is approached by a businessman with a plan that includes corporate espionage and time travel.

title: Between Silence and Truth
overview: In the wake of a devastating accident, a couple's crumbling relationship  faces a profound test as the wife's amnesia wipes away their painful history, leaving the husband torn between hidden grief and a delicate secret.

title: The Deputy
overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

title: Beneath It All
overview: Between takes on her first feature film, actress Remi is suddenly given direction that could significantly alter the course of her life. With only ten minutes to decide whether or not to stand up to the director, the film takes an unexpected turn.

title: The Stray House
overview: After losing his husband, a grieving widower inherits a rundown house and transforms it into a refuge for society’s outcasts—creating an unlikely chosen family that must stand together against prejudice, abuse, and the pain of the past.

title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
original_title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
overview: Spidey and the Avengers' Halloween plans are turned upside down by the mysterious Hallows' Eve, who plays magical tricks on trick or treaters and plans to ruin Halloween forever.

title: Chow Time
overview: In pursuit of the perfect meal, Brighton goes to battle with his six roommates over control of the kitchen.

title: The Swallow
overview: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

title: Troilus and Cressida
overview: In Troy, young prince Troilus and Cressida are in love. Greece and Troy have been fighting for years with no end in sight ever since Paris abducted Helen. The manufactured glamour of the Trojan war machine is losing its shine, and the Greek camp has declined into an apocalyptic wasteland. What happens when the heroes we worship no longer live up to their mythic narratives?

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: A Bear Life
overview: A Bear Life is about a brown bear who fishes for salmon, carefully stores his catch for later, and eventually prepares a meal as spring returns to the wilderness.

title: Behind The Lens
overview: "Kedipan Kamera" is a compelling short film that delves into a sharp yet empathetic social critique of contemporary community life. Through a series of poignant visual moments captured by a camera lens, the film explores the stark contrasts within public spaces, highlighting the invisible struggles of ordinary citizens. It challenges the audience to look past the surface of daily routines and recognize the deep human stories, socio-economic gaps, and emotional resilience embedded in the local environment.

title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
original_title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
overview: A four part ambiguation of "weirdness" in relation to the sublime. A sensory ode to incongruity. A brief and romantic gesture toward un-understanding. A prayer to the anti-self.

title: REO: The Dangerous Peak
overview: A documentary following a young mountaineer, Yashwanth Naik, on an expedition to Mount Reo Purgyil in Himachal Pradesh.

title: Happier Times
overview: Two friends reunite for the first time in a while & come to realize how much life has changed

title: Thomas Dambo: TROLLMAKER
overview: Tour the Denmark studio of world-renowned recycle artist Thomas Dambo, who transforms scrap wood and discarded trash into monumental troll sculptures hidden around the globe. TROLLMAKER explores the art, creative process, and environmental philosophy behind his mission to prove that waste can be transformed into magic. Watch the film by searching TROLLMAKER on YouTube!

title: Headscarf
overview: Chemotherapy leaves Candela feeling undesirable and unseen. To brave love again, she must confront her shame and reclaim her femininity.

title: The Feral Woman Who Lives in the Mountains
original_title: The Feral Woman Who Lives in the Mountains
overview: After years of reporting on sightings of a feral woman who lives in the mountains, a news anchor falls in love with the subject of his story and ventures into the mountains to find her.

title: Afternoons Feel Like Goodbyes
overview: Titi, a 24-year-old woman who has never felt a sense of meaning in her life, attempts to prepare for her own death by sewing a custom shroud, one she can wear by herself so as not to burden anyone when the time comes.

title: i’m so bad at billiards that i ended up in the hyperbolic plane
original_title: i’m so bad at billiards that i ended up in the hyperbolic plane
overview: Explores the mathematical concept of outer billiards, analyzing how different table geometries shape object trajectories. By visualizing starting positions and mapping complex singularities across various shapes, this short illustrates how simple geometric rules generate intricate, unpredictable patterns in both Euclidean and hyperbolic spaces.

title: The Path
overview: A film the follows Holly Beckham (Ngāpuhi) is on a mission to be the first Māori woman to scale Everest. She has no alpine experience, but she has survived the depths of addiction and is climbing a mountain to recovery.

title: Peculiar Green
overview: A middle-aged man with deity-like powers details the creation of his new world. A world characterized by a shade of green.

title: Premature
overview: After an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, two flatmates must confront who they are, and who they want to be, before the baby arrives.

title: The Depths
overview: After a brother and sister achieve astral projection, the footage they capture reveals the malicious effects of their family trauma.

title: Jimmy’s Custom Coffin
overview: Jimmy’s trying to put the fun back in funeral

title: Meat
overview: A young woman walks into a men’s support group, telling the tale of an awful night, when the hunter becomes the hunted.

title: Mascott
overview: In the absurd world of film and TV, Scott, a trans actor yearns for more than a stand-in career. When they land the lead role of Barry the Bear, the sudden fame and gender perceptions of this aggressive character take them for a ride.

title: Godmother
overview: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

title: Juvenescence
overview: An Australian coming of age comedy follows four teenagers navigating their final days at Edgewater High and all that comes with it.

title: Siren upon Tyne
overview: An ineffective Siren inhabiting the bank of Tyne has an existential crisis when she's abandoned by her shoal. Without the seductry tools to tempt pray by herself, she relies on the help of Geordie Fisherman Trev.

title: Blue Hour
overview: On the last day before leaving for university, a teenage girl spends one final summer afternoon roaming the Yorkshire moors with her closest friends, filming their last moments together as she struggles with the fear of leaving home behind.

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
original_title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom

title: The Veto
overview: For 80 years, the UN Security Council permanent member veto power has been the subject of constant debate, within the UN and without. The veto itself isn’t going away—it’s ‘veto-proof’. But when vetoes are cast in the face of genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity, obligations under international law and the UN Charter must be considered.  Such veto uses have led to massive loss of life, displacement of millions, and the multilateral order pushed to a breaking point.  The film, featuring leading global experts, puts aside ‘the impossibility of change’ and explores real paths to breaking the Security Council deadlock, and avoiding a third global conflict.  This is an urgent film for global audiences — it’s an issue that truly affects us all.

title: George Michael: The Trojan Souls

This is Trojan Souls — the film that tells the story of what almost was.

title: Prompt: Make a Documentary
overview: Prompt: Make a Documentary investigates the growing influence of artificial intelligence on the film industry.  The documentary places the rise of AI within the broader historical context of cinema’s evolution, drawing parallels with earlier technological shifts such as the introduction of sound, colour, and digital visual effects. By revisiting landmark moments in film history, the film demonstrates that disruption has always been part of cinema’s DNA, while questioning whether AI represents a fundamentally different kind of change.  Featuring insights from directors, academics, and practitioners, Prompt: Make a Documentary explores the tension between innovation and integrity, the democratisation of creative tools, and the ethical implications of automation in the arts. The film ultimately asks whether artificial intelligence will empower the next generation of storytellers or redefine creativity itself.

title: The Last Gift: Jim's Courage Our Hope
original_title: The Last Gift: Jim's Courage Our Hope
overview: The Last Gift: Jim’s Courage, Our Hope is a moving short documentary exploring the intersection of science, altruism, and human dignity at the end of life. The film follows Jim Dunn, a man living with HIV who chooses to participate in UC San Diego’s Last Gift Study, a pioneering research effort enabling people nearing death to donate their bodies to science immediately after passing, helping researchers uncover where HIV persists despite treatment.  Through intimate conversations, reflections on mortality, and moments shared with his wife Susan, clinicians, advocates, and scientists, the film reveals Jim’s profound desire to contribute to a future free of HIV. With honesty and grace, it captures the emotional complexity of end-of-life decisions and the extraordinary courage behind them. Jim’s legacy reminds us that scientific progress is built not only on data, but on human generosity, relationships, and hope.
